title: The App Market
drDigitalIntro:
Your computer has a built-in app market where you download new apps safely.
• Every app is reviewed before it is listed, so it is safer than random websites.
• Browse by category, search by name, or read reviews from other users.
• Check ratings and reviews before you install — other people's experiences help you decide.

steps.say: Click 'Games' to browse the Games category.
Click Zen Garden to see its details, reviews, and screenshots.
Notice the rating, reviews, and the 'No ads' tag. Now go back to the App Market.

drDigitalSuccess: You browsed the App Market! Ratings, reviews, and tags tell you a lot before you install. Always check them.
drDigitalHint: Click a category to browse, then click an app name to see its full listing.
